description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Transmission Shift Lever Repair Kit that repairs the shifter for all years of Suzuki Samurai 1985 thru 1995.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Cover, Lever Case
Qty 1 – Washer, Shift Lever
Qty 1 – Bush, Shift Lever
Qty 1 – Boot #2, Shift Lever
Qty 3 – Bolts for Cover
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
